displayIdentity.body: Believers take disputes before outside judges. Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints? No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.
displayIdentity.title: Believers take disputes before outside judges
